title: Learn piano without leaving your house thanks to this AI-powered app — now for less than $20 a year
excerpt: Learning piano as an adult doesn't have to be as intimidating as you think.
content_html:
TL;DR: Learn piano in your spare time with this five-year subscription to flowkey Piano Learning App Classic Plan, now just $79.99 (reg. $899).

Credit: Flowkey

$79.99
$899 Save $819.01

Learning something new as an adult can be intimidating… and humbling. flowkey Piano Learning App solves for that — letting you master the piano from the privacy of your own home, with no teacher judging your mistakes.

This AI-powered tool helps you go from beginner to pro in private, and this five-year subscription to the flowkey Piano Learning App Classic Plan is on sale now for just $79.99.

Want to learn piano without leaving your house? flowkey Piano Learning App makes it possible, offering lessons that fit into your spare time. All you need is a keyboard or piano, and a device to run the app.

flowkey offers step-by-step courses that range from beginner to intermediate, advanced, and pro levels. The AI-powered interactive learning lets you practice notes and chords and get real-time feedback as you go, as it can listen while you play.

Mashable Trend Report

The app is packed with features that make learning easier. A loop function lets you repeat difficult sections until you master them, while hand selection lets you practice your left and right hands separately.

Slow-motion mode reduces playback so you can take your time learning. There’s also wait mode that only lets you progress after you play the right notes, and the option to watch expert pianists play as you follow along.

These interactive lessons help you master chords and learn music theory as you play. Your subscription also provides access to over 1,000 classical and public-domain songs, including music by Beethoven and Bach.

Get this five-year subscription to flowkey Piano Learning App Classic Plan for only $79.99.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
